labels.name: Hair shaft
labels.function: Keratinized strand projecting above the skin surface

labels.name: Epidermis
labels.function: Outer layer; releases cathelicidin after toll-like receptor activation

labels.name: Dermis
labels.function: Middle layer that receives spilled contents when a plugged pore bursts

labels.name: Subcutaneous tissue
labels.function: Deepest layer that hidradenitis inflammation can reach

labels.name: Hair follicle
labels.function: Tube that clogs with keratin and sebum in acne and hidradenitis

labels.name: Sebaceous gland
labels.function: Androgen receptors drive its hyperplasia and oil output at puberty

labels.name: Arrector pili muscle
labels.function: Small smooth muscle; third part of the pilosebaceous unit

labels.name: Microcomedo
labels.function: Earliest plug: anaerobic, lipid-rich space where bacteria multiply

labels.name: Cutibacterium acnes
labels.function: Gram-positive flora; triggers the NLRP3 inflammasome and TLRs

labels.name: Closed comedo
labels.function: Debris-filled follicle with skin covering the pore

labels.name: Open comedo
labels.function: Debris-filled follicle exposed to air, giving a dark top

labels.name: Ruptured follicle wall
labels.function: Break that spills keratin, sebum and bacteria into the dermis

labels.name: Neutrophils
labels.function: Cells recruited by IL-8 and IL-12 to the rupture site

labels.name: Pustule
labels.function: Superficial raised dome filled with white-yellow exudate

labels.name: Nodule
labels.function: Deep inflammatory lesion most likely to leave a scar
